channel.title: Thomas Mason's Internet Journal
channel.description: This is my internet journal. This is where I re-publish content I like that I find on the internet. You should make one too (https://thomasmason.us/pages/posts/internet-journaling.html).

item.title: FairVote
item.description: An organization of people doing whatever they can accross the country to implement voting systems that prevent corruption instead of fueling it as our current systems do.

item.title: See You Again - Tyler, The Creator
Robot Pencil
item.description: Found a nice channel where a guy talks about stuff while painting digitally. Here's the first video I saw that inspired me to subscribe.

item.title: Hypertext TV
item.description: A website that pretends to be an old TV that hosts webpages at different times of the day, just like how TV's host different channels throughout the day. It has a large, constantly-changing collection of cool content.

item.title: Cloudhiker
item.description: "Discover the most interesting, weird and awesome Websites of the Internet"

item.title: Journaling tips from Struthless
item.description: One of my favorite Youtubers, Struthless, made a video where he outlines his VOMIT journalling system. The idea is to help people get a better idea of how they can sit down at a blank page and journal in an actually useful way.

item.title: Art of Manliness RSS
item.description: This blog posts a lot of great content about embracing wholesome manliness. I especially like the Odds & Ends posts.

item.title: HIDARI
item.description: A stop-motion samurai film done anime style that's in the works. It probably won't be out for a while, but it's darn cool!

item.title: Cool song: The Sorcerer
item.description: I liked this song. It's an instrumental.
